name: Short-Stay Visa / Visa-Free Entry (Schengen)

requirements.blocker_text: Bulgaria applies the Schengen short-stay rule: up to 90 days within any 180-day period, whether entering visa-free or on a Type C visa (Foreigners Act Article 14(1)).
Entrants must hold a valid travel document, proof of sufficient financial means for subsistence and return travel, and medical/travel insurance (Foreigners Act Article 19(1)).
Nationals of countries not covered by EU Regulation 2018/1806's visa-exemption list must obtain a Type C short-stay visa before travel; others may enter visa-free for the same 90/180-day allowance.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Type C visa at a Bulgarian embassy/consulate if not visa-exempt.

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bulgaria). Bulgaria applies the full Schengen short-stay framework (90/180 days) since joining the Schengen area (air/sea borders March 2024, land borders January 2025). Visa requirement is nationality-dependent per EU Regulation 2018/1806, modeled as a soft (hard:false) branch since it varies by the applicant's nationality rather than being a fixed universal condition.
